description: This file defines the 'SessionActions' enum with static methods for session management, including patching, resetting, deleting, compacting sessions, and UI interactions related to session logs. It interacts with 'ControlChannel' and uses AppKit for UI alerts.

methods.name: patchSession
methods.description: Patches a session with optional thinking and verbose levels by sending a request via ControlChannel.

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Resets the session identified by the specified key.

methods.name: deleteSession
methods.description: Deletes the session and its transcript based on the key.

methods.name: compactSession
methods.description: Compacts the session transcript to a maximum number of lines.

methods.name: confirmDestructiveAction
methods.description: Shows a warning alert to confirm destructive actions, returning true if confirmed.

methods.name: presentError
methods.description: Displays an error alert with the provided title and Error object.

methods.name: openSessionLogInCode
methods.description: Attempts to locate and open the session log in Visual Studio Code or falls back to the file viewer.
